decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 5 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 6 - The number of the shop shall be displayed on the fascia in a clearly visible location.

Condition : 7 - Reason for Approval

The proposed internally illuminated fascia and projecting sign, by way of its size, design, scale, and location would be compatible with the nature of the surrounding built environment and would not have a detrimental impact on traffic safety, the appearance of the subject building or the local street scene.  The proposal is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and supplementary planning guidance.
description: Installation of internally illuminated shop fascia and projecting sign.
